Info Edge's Investment Strategy and Growth Trajectory Under Scrutiny

Info Edge (India), known for its investments in consumer technology, is facing questions regarding its future growth. The company has a history of significant investments in AI and deep tech, including a notable success with Zomato. However, emerging risks and uncertain cash flows are posing challenges to its ability to maintain its growth trajectory. Analysts are examining whether its AI and startup investments can offset a slowdown in its recruitment business.
